examples.title: Точки компании и подчинение
sql: SELECT w.WarehouseID, w.WarehouseName, w.Kind, w.Country, p.WarehouseName AS Parent
LEFT JOIN Warehouses p ON p.WarehouseID = w.ParentID

examples.title: Отследить посылку
sql: SELECT s.TrackNo, s.Status, s.CreatedAt, wf.WarehouseName AS FromPoint, wt.WarehouseName AS ToPoint,
JOIN Warehouses wf ON wf.WarehouseID = s.FromWarehouseID
JOIN Warehouses wt ON wt.WarehouseID = s.ToWarehouseID
LEFT JOIN Trips t ON t.TripID = s.TripID

examples.title: Как считается стоимость
sql: SELECT TOP (20) s.TrackNo, s.WeightKg, t.TariffName, t.PricePerKg, t.MinPrice,
JOIN Tariffs t ON t.TariffID = s.TariffID

examples.title: Выручка по месяцам
sql: SELECT FORMAT(CreatedAt, 'yyyy-MM') AS Mon, COUNT(*) AS Shipments, CAST(SUM(Cost) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Revenue

examples.title: Рейсы в пути и запланированные
sql: SELECT t.TripNo, t.Transport, wf.WarehouseName AS FromPoint, wt.WarehouseName AS ToPoint, t.DepartAt, t.Status,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Shipments s WHERE s.TripID = t.TripID) AS Parcels
JOIN Warehouses wf ON wf.WarehouseID = t.FromWarehouseID
JOIN Warehouses wt ON wt.WarehouseID = t.ToWarehouseID

examples.title: Доставка в срок по тарифам
sql: SELECT tr.TariffName, tr.DaysNorm, COUNT(*) AS Arrived,
SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, s.CreatedAt, t.ArriveAt) <= tr.DaysNorm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OnTime
JOIN Trips t ON t.TripID = s.TripID
JOIN Tariffs tr ON tr.TariffID = s.TariffID

examples.title: Претензии на рассмотрении
sql: SELECT c.ClaimID, c.ClaimDate, c.Reason, s.TrackNo, cu.CustomerName, s.DeclaredValue
JOIN Shipments s ON s.ShipmentID = c.ShipmentID
JOIN Customers cu ON cu.CustomerID = s.CustomerID

examples.title: Две базы: клиенты карго — клиенты банка
sql: SELECT c.CustomerName, c.Phone, b.ClientID AS BankClientID, COUNT(s.ShipmentID) AS Shipments
JOIN Bank.dbo.Clients b ON b.Phone = c.Phone
LEFT JOIN Cargo.dbo.Shipments s ON s.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

examples.title: USE: переключение базы
sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS CurrentDb, COUNT(*) AS Clients FROM Clients;
examples.note: После выполнения песочница переключится на базу Bank — как в SSMS.
